::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 6th [1872?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)

I think if you told [Warne](people/person_1433.qmd)that you had had an offer from [Smith and Elder](organizations/other_238.qmd) he would be sure to take your story.  The stupid man has just refused Florence Wilford’s [dominie](other_books/otherbook_816.qmd) and ought to be  scarified.[^1]  I shall have [Joanna](people/person_1154.qmd)and [Fanny Patteson](people/person_1154.qmd) with me on the 20th, and it is also the time of one of the [lectures](organizations/other_240.qmd), so it will depend on a good many things whether I shall have the pleasant sight of you.

your affectionate
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Florence Wilford, *Dominie Freylinghausen* (London, Mozley 1875).  It ran as a serial in *MP* ns 13 (January-June 1872).
